paragraph: Granville’s timing system issues a mildly constructive primary verdict with a composite reading of 56/100, operating without an active breadth divergence warning. Internal market signals show solid participation led by broad equities (RSP/SPY +0.76%) and economic bellwether transports (IYT/SPY +1.14%), though strong defensive rotation (XLP/XLY +3.11%) and soft high-beta appetite (SPHB/SPLV -0.97%) indicate underlying institutional caution. Macro conditions reinforce this balanced backdrop, as a calm VIX at 19.47 sits in a normal contango structure (14.1 to 21.1) alongside stable high-yield credit spreads at 2.68% and 10-year real yields anchored at 2.37%. Meanwhile, small-cap relative strength (0.3949) provides a buffer against a firming dollar ($28.58) and a back-loaded volatility skew of -5.3 points. Lean modestly bullish for the session, favoring broad-market cyclical breadth over concentrated high-beta risk.
